messages.content: What brings you back into the clinic today, miss?
I came in for a refill of my blood pressure medicine.
Have you noticed any changes or do you have any concerns regarding these issues?
No.
Have you had any fever or chills, cough, congestion, nausea, vomiting, chest pain, chest pressure?
How're you feeling today?
Terrible. I'm having the worst headache of my life.
When did it start?
Around eleven in the morning.
Today?
Um no yesterday. July thirty first.
Did it come on suddenly?
Yeah.
Are you having any symptoms with it, such as blurry vision, light sensitivity, dizziness, lightheadedness, or nausea?
I'm having blurry vision and lightheadedness. I also can't seem to write well. It looks so messy. I am naturally right handed but my writing looks like I am trying with my left.
How would you describe the lightheadedness?
Like there are blind spots.
How about any vomiting?
What is the reason for your visit today?
I think I have some warts on my back end where the poop comes out.
When did you start noticing them?
I think like three to four weeks ago.
Do you feel any pain or discomfort?
It itches a little, but I haven't felt any pain yet. Is this normal for a twenty two year old?
Are there any other symptoms that you are aware of?
Do you smoke?
No, I quit before I had my daughter.
Are you currently pregnant?
No, I'm not.
Did you have any complications with the birth of your daughter?
I actually had a C section.
Have you had any other surgeries in the past?
I got my appendix out a few years ago.
Do you have any other issues, like high blood pressure or heart disease?
No.
Do you have diabetes?
No.
Are there any problems with the lungs, thyroid, kidney, or bladder?
No.
So, how long ago did you hurt your lower back?
It was about four or five years ago now, when I was in a car crash.
What kind of treatments were recommended?
How are you today?
Hello! I am good.
What do you know about their medical history?
My mother and father both had heart disease. Well, my mother had complication from her heart disease and that is how she passed. My father was only in his forty's when he died.
They both had polio?
One of them had to wear crutches due to how bad his leg deformans were and then the other had leg deformities in only one leg. I am fairly certain that they had polio.
Do you know of any other family member with neurological conditions?
No. None that I know of.
Do you have any children?
Yes. I have one child.
Is your child healthy and well?
First, how old are you?
I'm nineteen, sir.
Is that correct?
Yes, sir, that's correct.
What seems to be the problem today, ma'am?
I've had this bunion on my foot for such a long time.
How long has this bunion been present?
At this point, um, I don't even remember how long it's been.
Do you have any other conditions that I should be aware of?
I hear someone has a birthday coming up, how old are you turning, ma'am?
I'll be ninety later this month, doctor.
What seems to be the problem today?
Well, actually, my high blood pressure and right arm symptoms are basically gone.
Are you taking the higher dose of Mavik we recommended?
No, I'm not taking that right now.
How did you tolerate the higher dose?
I didn't feel well at all, so I just went back to the old dose.
That was one M G per day, correct?

Yes, doctor. I do think I could have some white coat high blood pressure. Doctors' offices make me nervous. Hello doctor, I'm her daughter. Just so you know, we check her blood pressure at home periodically and it's always similar to that reading.
so back to that right arm, how is that doing today?
Well, that pain is basically gone now, I think it had to do with that muscle problem back in my right shoulder blade.
Did you have x rays taken today?
Yes, the tech brought me back right before you came in.
The humeral head is pretty high in the glenoid in the right shoulder, but do you have any pain here?
No, none.
How has this pain developed and progressed recently?
Well, it's improved somewhat with me not taking Aleve anymore.
What medicines are you taking right now, then?
Right know, I'm just taking Tylenol as needed. That seems to be enough for me.
Do you think this could be acid reflux, or heartburn?
No, but I take Tums, um, three times a day, and Mylanta at night. Oh yeah, I have these sores in my mouth, can you take a look?
How long have you worn dentures?
Oh I couldn't even tell you, it's been many, many years.
Do they come and go, the sores?
Yes, one will come, then it'll heal up, then another.
It's hard to tell if you have a tremor today, ma'am, but do you think the Lexapro is helping otherwise?
How old are you?
I am forty four.
Are you right handed or left handed?
I'm right handed.
Was there any sensation like having pins and needles?
I was able to walk and there was no weakness or any other thing you mentioned.
When did you first start noticing these symptoms?

There was nothing around Independence Day. It all started after that. At first, I felt that my right hand is very clumsy, and it is kind of stiff. Then I noticed leaning towards the right when walking. It was strange. Happened around July seventh.
Did you recently have any cold or flu like symptoms?
No.
Were you diagnosed with a thing called multiple sclerosis?
No.
Did you ever have a feeling where you felt like there's an electric is going up or down your spine?
No.
How about any fatigue or pain?
How old are you, young boy?
I am twenty nine.
And you got right side shoulder pain?
Yes. That is right.
What were you doing when this happened?
I think I was picking up a stack of cardboard, then putting it down on the ground and twisting to the right side. And sometimes I was throwing them a little bit as well.
and how far you were lifting them or bending?
Around here, till waist level.
And when did this all start?
When did the nausea and vomiting start?
About a few hours ago. I can't seem to stomach anything.
How many episodes of vomiting have you had?
At least four.
Any abdominal pain, fever, chill, or other symptoms?
Do you know about any medical traits in your family?
No, everyone in my family is quite healthy. I'm not aware of any medical problems.
Are you sexually active?
Yes, I am with my boyfriend.
Do you take any drugs or alcohol or smoke?
Any past medical history?
Um there were a couple times where I noticed my blood pressure was high but that's improved as of late.
When did these episodes occur?
About a year ago.
Did you follow up with your previous doctor?
Yeah, my old doctor knows.
Have you been checking your own blood pressure as a result?
No not really.
any allergies to medications?
None that I know of.
Any new diet changes or stressors?
I lost my job last January and it took a pretty big toll on me.
How have you been coping?
How old are you?
I'm twenty four.
So, what brought you here?
I was out for fishing this weekend, I think I got into some poison ivy and I have these rashes all over my chest, legs, arms and also some are on my back.
You seem so confident of it being poison ivy has it happened before?
Oh yes, it has happened several times before. It usually takes some time to get over. Last time I was here Doctor Blackman gave me a steroid injection.
How was it last time after the injection?
It worked fine. It did take us some time to get rid of it.
Did you take any medicine or anything else this time?
I took over the counter Benadryl. Also, I'm applying cortisone cream on the rashes.
Did they help you?
Hi, what brings you here today?
I feel this lump on the upper side of my breast.
Both sides?
No, only on the left side.
Do you feel it deep inside or closer to the outer side?
You okay there?
Uh yeah, sorry. I'm just trying to adjust the stretcher.
Want some help?
No, thank you. I think I got it.
So how're you doing?
Fine, but I have this weird lump in my chest.
When did you first notice it?
It's been there for a while. I'd say almost half a year.
Have you seen anyone for it?
No, not until now.
Is it causing you pain?
Not really. It's just noticeable when I run my fingers over it.
Have you spotted any swelling or redness to the area?
I will ask you some regular questions, okay? Any pain in urination?
Nope.
Any fever or chills?
Neither of them.
Have you noticed any blood while urinating?

Nope. I do leak, especially when I'm changing my positions like from sitting to standing so I do feel there is some involuntary urination. It's more like a urge. I'm loading data in like every one hour in the morning, especially when I take that Lasix.
Does it taper off in the afternoon or night?
It tapers off in the afternoon. And by the night I don't do not feel anything.
Any leakage in the night?
Nope.
Do you apply a lot of force to urinate?
Nope.
How about this stream?
Have you lost weight?
No, I haven't, you can ask my daughter.
How about anything like fever, nausea, vomiting, pain?
No.
And you get urine infections too?
Yes.
And as discussed, your drainage is similar to past episodes when you had such infection?
Do you use tobacco products?
I used to smoke a pack a day. I quit that awful habit in nineteen eighty five.
Do you work?
I am retired.
Is your husband retired with you?
Hi there, how are you?
I am okay.
And you are referred by Doctor X, he is your primary physician, right?
Correct! I am also seeing Doctor Y for my leukemia.
So, tell me what is happening with you?
For the past one week I am having this increased shortness of breath and having difficulty breathing from past few nights while sleeping.
Any dizziness, feeling like fainting or light headedness or losing control?
How are you today?
Fifty eight. I feel like my balance is off, and I've been feeling tired and weak.
How long have you been experiencing this?
It's been going on for six to eight weeks.
Did you feel any other symptoms?
I haven't, but this might not be related. I had pneumonia ten days before this all started.
Did you take any medication for that?
I did, but I don't know how to pronounce it. I wrote it down for you to read. Here it is.
you took a full course of amoxicillin, right?
Yeah, that's right.
How did you feel after you finished the antibiotics?
Terrible. I felt like I couldn't control my body. My balance got even worse, and I felt even more tired and weak.
Do you know why your balance and coordination worsened?
I did fall recently, but I know for a fact my balance was off before my fall.
How high were you when you fell?
I think I was three or five feet high when I fell.
Did you fall on your back?
No, I fell on my feet. Just kidding, I fell on my back.
Did anything hurt after your fall?
Not really, but I've been having some back pain in my lower and mid back.
Did you always have that pain?
No, I haven't. It comes and goes.
Have you done anything to treat it?
I started to see a chiropractor like five days ago. He adjusts my neck and lower back.
Did you start having problems with your balance after this?
No. I was still having problems with that before I saw the chiropractor.
Is there anything else that may have caused it?
I was taking this other medicine for ten days, but I don't remember what it was for. Here is the name of the medication. I wrote it on another paper.
Were you aware you had a U T I?
Oh, yeah. I forgot about that. I thought I had one, so I went to another doctor to get some medication.
Do you have any trouble controlling your bowel movements or attempting to go to the bathroom?
My nurse tells me you're twenty eight years old, is that correct?
Good morning, doctor. Yes, that's correct.
So, what happened?
Well, I punched a wall about three days ago.
Which hand is it?
It's my right hand.
Is this your dominant hand?
Unfortunately, yes, it is.
Where does it hurt?
Um, it's right here on the outside of my hand.
What kind of treatments have you had?
I went to the E D, and they pushed some of the joints in my hand back, and they put me in a splint, so I've been wearing that ever since.
How is your pain today?
Compared to when it started, it's much better today.
How would you describe your pain today?
Today, I'd say it's minimal pain.
Do you have any numbness or tingling today?
How old was he when he were first evaluated in the other hospital?
He was seven.
Which hospital was that again?
It was at U I H C.
So what exactly happened?

He was doing all good like seven months before his evaluation, then he started having some dizzy spells, which like stayed for several seconds to a minute. They were not regular, but he was able to continue his activity immediately after these dizzy spells.
Did the intensity change?
Oh yes. This, these spells, they became more frequent, and they were now for longer periods. By the time we came for the first evaluation, they were like two to three times per day.
How long did each episode last?
They lasted for like two to three minutes.
Did you notice any other symptoms during the episodes?
Are you still working?
No, I am retired now. I used to work for the U S postal service as an electronic technician but took retirement one year earlier due to my disability.
And who is in your family?
Well, I stay with my wife and daughter in our apartment.
Do you smoke?
No.
How about alcohol?
I use to drink occasionally, that too very rare, but after my symptoms stated I stopped completely.
Any use of recreational or illegal drugs?
Nope.
Did you travel anywhere recently?
Where do you live?
I live in a board and care. It is a nice small care home with some very nice and supportive people. It is just next to the Safeway on Village Drive.
Did you consume alcohol in any way?
No Sir.
Any tobacco consumption?
Never in my life.
Did you ever try any kind of illicit drugs?
Sir?
Yes. I am his wife.
How old is he?
He is eighty five. He took the entire M G of Xanax. He is only supposed to take point one twenty five M G of Xanax. That is why he is like this.
How did these injuries to his face happen?
He fell off his wheelchair.
How long had he been that way?
All day.
Do you know what other medications your husband has taken other than the Xanax?
Where do you work, miss?
Well, you see, I am a civil engineer. Right now, due to pandemic like everyone else I am working from home.
Are you working full time or is your disability affecting that?
No, I can only work on half time. This disability does not let me work full time. I need to go to physical therapy quite frequently on and off and I also have a baby who consumes a lot of my time.
Do you smoke or drink?
How are you doing today?
Yeah. Still a good amount of pain. I did not take my pain medication this morning though. Not sure if that will make a huge difference.
How is movement?
Yes. I am quite happy that I can do my daily activities. I can get up with minimal assistance and do many activities out of the house. I think I am gaining muscle from moving around more too.
How is the home exercise program going?
Are you sexually active?
Yes.
How many partners do you have?
Just one.
Is this a monogamous relationship?
Yes.
What is your partner's gender?
Do you have any medical problems?
Let's see. I have diabetes, high blood pressure, high cholesterol, and osteoporosis.
And any surgeries?
Several.
Which ones?

I had my tonsils taken out when I was a kid. I also had my uterus removed along with my ovaries and fallopian tubes. The list goes on. I had my appendix removed and two or three of my parathyroids taken out. Despite getting some of my parathyroids removed, I still have borderline high calcium levels according to my endocrinologist.
Did you experience any complications during or after surgery?
What is your family medical history?

My mother passed away from complications with Huntington Disease. She was diagnosed and had been having treatments at U I H C. My grandmother and two of my aunts also passed away from Huntington as well.
Do you have siblings?
Yes! I have one sister. She is thirty eight. She has a lot of metal issues. She has attempted suicide two times.
Are you close with her?
No. Not really.
Are you married?
Yes.
Do you have children?
here that you're not able to go up the stairs well, can you tell me more about that?
Yeah, I can't use the stairs without holding the rail the entire time.
Holding the rail makes navigating the stairs easier?
Yeah, but I still move very slow.
Do you smoke?
Yeah, I smoke about a pack to a pack and a half a day.
What about exercise?
So, what is your family's living situation at home?
Um, he lives at home with me, and his father.
May I assume that you are his biological parents?
Yes, that's correct.
does he have any siblings?
No, right now, he's an only child.
What grade is he in?
He's in the third grade.
How is he doing in school?
afternoon, what gender do you identify with?
Thank you for asking, I identify as a female.
Do you know of any chronic illnesses?
No, but can you give me some examples of what you mean?
Do any of these conditions sound familiar: high blood pressure, osteoarthritis, diabetes, or depression?
My chart here says that you're eighty three years old, is that correct, ma'am?
Yes doctor, that's correct, I just had my birthday.
How have you been doing since your last visit?
Well, my cancer hasn't needed phlebotomies for several months now, which is good.
you have been treated for polycythemia vera, correct?
How are you feeling today?
I'm just here for my yearly physical.
Do you, by chance, know if you've had any health related problems before?
Uhm. Let me check my notes on my phone. I knew this question would pop up, but I always forget. Oh, perfect. You can take a look at them.
Do you have a history of asthma, nasal inflammation, or a growth on your neck?
How's the little one doing?
She is doing okay.
How long was your pregnancy?
Thirty six weeks.
Was your delivery normal or C section?
It was a C section.
How much did she weigh?
She was eight pounds and three ounces.
Tell me what's the issue?
Yeah, she has a history of seizures. It looks like she is having pain in her tummy and is throwing up.
What else did you notice?
What medications are you taking right now?
I am taking Advair and Allegra.
is it helping you?
I don't know, I am not sure the Allegra is helping. But I do take them regularly.
But is it like better than Claritin?
How are you today?
Hi! I am good.
Are you a tobacco or alcohol user?
No.
Are you married?
I am not married but I do have a two year old son.
Do you currently see a gynecologist?
Do you smoke?
No, I don't. Smoking is gross.
Do you drink alcohol?
Yes.
How much do you drink per day or week?
How's she doing?
She's had better days.
Aw and why's that?

She's been really congested recently. Snorting a lot more, too. She's onlt eleven and I think it is odd she snores so much. I took her to see the allergist and he said it's not her allergies so we stopped giving her Allegra.
Does she happen to snore at night?
No, not really.
Have you applied anything to the area?
What is wrong with your back honey?
Oh, it all started off with a little pimple on the buttock. I was soaking it at home with hot water and stuff, but it did not improve. I hope this is not cancer. I am only twenty four.
what exactly are you experiencing?
I have pain.
So you came to the hospital on the first and they did an I and D in E D?
Yes I was admitted to the hospitalist service with high blood sugars. My African American father was so scared.
Do you know the number?
No, I do not know that but they found positive bacteria or some sort of thing in my blood culture.
So today we are evaluating you for surgery?
How are you today?
I am alright. I am here for a check up since I am feeling kind of dizzy lately.
How long has this been happening?
A few months. This happened to my sister too. I think she is still dealing with it.
Is there any other family medical history I should know about?
Hi, how are you doing today?
I've been better. Thank you.
So, you are here for your follow up right?
That's right. I'm coming around between a month or two.
How long ago did you get that transplant?

I think it was around four and a half years ago. I'm feeling much better after that. I do have complaints of blood in my stool. But after you sent me to that doctor, that gastro doctor, I feel good. I know they said that they removed something, but I'm not sure, but after that it has been improved a lot.
That's good news, right?
Yeah, I agree. That was a relief.
Is there any other issue that I can help you with?
I understand, before we begin, how old are you?
I'm seventy seven years young.
What's seems to be causing you pain today?
I've had this bunion on my foot for as long as I can remember.
Is the pain worsening?
Yes, it is so painful, I've tried to avoid surgery for so long, but I want this bunion gone.
How have you managed this bunion in the past?
Did you have any medical disorders previously, sir?
I have diabetes. Also, I was quite overweight.
Are you taking any medications for that?

Yes, I was still taking something called Zyprexa, but I stopped it after my last regular weight check. Also, I never took anything for diabetes. I also have chronic bronchitis for… I don't know… many years.
Do you smoke?
Oh yes, I am a smoker.
How many cigarettes do you smoke in a day?
Any continuous ringing or thumping noises you may hear?
No, nothing like that.
Any hearing problems?
Um, no.
Any dizziness or spinning sensation?
You're eighty two years old, is that correct?
Good morning, doctor. Yes, that's correct.
and just one more piece of background information, which hand do you write with?
I use my right hand for everything.
so what seems to be the problem today?
Doctor, I've had years of pain in this shoulder.
What kind of treatments have you had?
Well, um, I've had antiinflammatories, and rested, and none of it has helped so far.
How is the pain affecting your daily activities?
Can you confirm your age for me, ma'am?
Absolutely, I'm sixty six now.
What seems to be the problem today?
I'm having some right shoulder pain.
Can you remember an injury to this shoulder?
No, not that I can remember.
What aggravates your symptoms?
It hurts when I move the shoulder.
Do you have any weakness, numbness, or tingling?
No, I don't have any of that.
back to diabetes, how has that been progressing?
Well, I can only check it in the morning, and it's usually less than one hundred.
Have you been checking your blood sugar two hours after meals?
No, doctor, I haven't been. When I check them, it's normal though.
Do you have any records to prove that?
No, I don't have that with me today.
That's important, do you have any other issues or concerns today?
No, I can't think of anything.
Did you have a repeat done after six months like they asked?
Do you mind giving me a run down of his past medical history?
I'll start with his surgeries. If I remember correctly, he had back surgery, a couple knee surgeries, and coronary artery bypass surgery with angioplasty.
When did he have these done?

I'd have to check, but I know he had back surgery in O nine. He has a history of high blood pressure and high cholesterol. He was recently diagnosed with B P H potentially linked to cancer. It's B P H, right? Or is it B H P?
Is he currently experiencing any symptoms?
How long have you been living with diabetes, sir?
Oh, it's been about thirty five years now.
How long have you been taking insulin for this?
Well, um, I've been taking insulin for about twenty years now.
Do you have any major medical conditions that I should know about?
Yeah, um, prostate cancer.
How were you treated for this?
Any difficulty in swallowing?
No.
Any nausea, vomiting or blood in your vomit?
No, no vomit at all. No problem there.
any stomach pain?
Are you a smoker?
I used to smoke. I quit in nineteen sixty eight.
Have you weighed your self recently?
I weighed myself this morning. I am at one hundred and eighty three pounds.
And how tall are you?
Was there a cause of the seizures?
About seven years ago I had a traumatic stroke. They told me I had bleeding in the brain. After the stroke I was left with this weakness on my right side.
What part of your body is affected by the weakness?
My arm, hand, and my face.
Do you have any other health problems?
My liver is falling. It is because of all the alcohol that I have consumed over the years. I am not drinking anymore.
Are you being treated for your liver disfunctions?
No. I just stopped drinking. I think I have diabetes.
What makes you feel like you have diabetes?
How old are you?
I am sixteen.
Are you okay?
No I have a really bad migraine.
can you point to where you are feeling it the most?
Here, since Monday.
so mostly on the right frontal side and it's been forty eight hours now?
Yes, I am feeling a lot of pressure.
Is it continuous or throbbing?
It is throbbing.
On the scale of one to ten, ten being the worst, how would you rate it?
Nine or more.
Have you ever experienced similar symptoms in the past?
No I haven't.
Did you hit your head buy any chance?
No no.
can you tell me if you have any fever or chills, congestion, cough cold like symptoms?
No.
Any nausea, vomiting, diarrhea or trauma anywhere?
No nothing like that.
Are you having any other symptoms anywhere else?
How are you doing today?

I have a long history of lung disease. COPD to be exact. Recently, I was experiencing a lot of coughing and shortness of breath even on walking from one room to another. All the time I felt sleepy, tired, or confused.
How is it now?
It is getting better.
What else?

I was also diagnosed with pneumonia; I was on trip and there they found it. It is also getting a lot better now, but doctor said to continue taking oxygen for some more time. I also felt very instable and had a fall. I did not call for any assistance but now I think I should have called someone. Everyone including my family and nurses all tell me all the time to call for assistance. I was just being stubborn and hurt myself.
Did you use a wheelchair?
Do you use tobacco products, alcohol, or recreational drugs, miss?
I have a drink every once and a while.
How many drinks do you consume in a week?
I don't even drink that often. I probably have one drink per month.
Are you married?
I was engaged but that is not happening anymore. It is a long story.
What do you do for work?
I just quickly wanted to check few things, let's go over them together? Any heart condition like heart failure or anything?
No.
Any heart catheterization?
Um, no.
Any history of chest pain, palpitation, or irregular heartbeat?
No.
Do you have high blood pressure?
No.
Any history of high cholesterol?
No.
Any excessive or abnormal sweating?
Not really, no.
Any stress test or heart tests done recently?
Around what time did the car crash take place?
About forty five minutes ago. I think someone called nine one one shortly after it happened.
Do you happen to remember how fast you were driving at the time of the crash?
I was driving about forty miles an hour.
What kind of car were you driving?
A minivan. The car in front of me stopped suddenly and I hit them right from behind. The front of my car is pretty wrecked.
Were you wearing a seatbelt?
Yes and yes.
Any passengers in the car with you?
No, just me.
Did you hit your head anywhere?
No, but I do have some pain on the left side of my neck.
Do you think you lost consciousness at any point in time?
Actually, I do. Right after the crash.
Any pain elsewhere?
Um I'm having some pain in my lower stomach area. I think it could be due to slamming into the airbag or steering wheel.
How would you rate this pain, ten being the worst pain ever?
Um I'd give it a five out of ten right now.
Any knee, ankle, or foot pain?
No.
How about pain in your shoulders, elbows, or wrists?
Uh no, but I guess I do have a little bit of pain in my pelvic area.
Do you remember walking before or after the ambulance arrived?
I don't think so. Someone told me that I was placed on the stretcher after they got me out of the car.
Just to confirm, no chest pain or difficulty breathing?
No.
Have you noticed any cuts on your skin?
No.
Any headache, nausea, or vomiting?
No.
Fever or chills?
No.
Any chance of pregnancy?
No, I've been good at taking my birth control and I also have an I U D.
When was your last period?
Um end of May I believe.
Are you taking anything besides birth control?
Can you tell me more about your parents, please?
Thank you for asking, they're both doing very well. They're very healthy.
How old are they?
My mom is fifty, and my dad is forty.
do you have any siblings?
Yeah, I have two sisters, one is a half sister, and the other we have the same mom and dad. My half sister and I have the same mom, and she's thirty four. My other sister is ten.
Do they have any history of medical conditions that you know about?
Hello sir, what brings you here today?
I am seventy years old. I am here for nothing particular but I just have discomfort on the right side.
When did you first notice this discomfort?
About five years ago. After my stroke. I've been to a neurologist before.
How often do you check your sugar levels?
I do it at home. Mainly two to three times a day. I increase or decrease the amount of insulin that I take based on my numbers.
Don't you consult anyone before doing that?
It's been so many years now. I do it all by myself.
Do you smoke?
How is your arm feeling?
My arm is all better. It is not in pain at all anymore.
How has your mood been?
It's helping a little bit.
How much Lexapro are you taking now?
I am taking ten M G.
How long have you been taking the full dosage?
About a week ago. I don't take it every day. I don't feel like I need it some days.
Is this a normal occurrence for you?
